name: G026 frameset

editorial.verdict: One of the cheapest frames with T47, UDH, storage, and 50 mm clearance; best suited to a risk-tolerant custom builder.
caveats: Less independent verification and test disclosure

purchase_route: Current exact SPcycle direct storefront lists US$998 regular / US$718 sale, stock, buy-now and add-to-cart. Confirm selected finish and cockpit, shipping, tax, warranty, stock and mainland checkout before paying.
